public_rationale: The readable filing reports revenue growth, but revenue is broader than the specified GPU spending. More importantly, growth through July 2026 cannot disprove an eventual decline. No decisive event meeting the resolution rule was established, and the spending measure remains unspecified.
limitations: Supplier revenue is not identical to customer cash spending.
A temporary or regional product decline would not establish an aggregate decline.
The forecast cannot be assigned a deadline the speaker did not provide.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Spending on NVIDIA GPUs will eventually have to decline.

statement.excerpt: At some point reality will set in and spending on NVIDIA GPUs will have to decline.
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

our_interpretation: Read this as a forecast of an eventual fall in aggregate spending on NVIDIA GPUs used for AI.
A decline means a lower monetary amount, not merely slower growth.
Comparable annual spending would provide a clear test; the speaker did not specify a comparison frequency or require a particular percentage decline.
NVIDIA total revenue and Data Center revenue are imperfect proxies because they include products and services beyond the specified GPUs.
The statement specifies no accounting basis, currency, or reporting calendar.
criteria.support_condition: A verified post-publication decline in aggregate spending on the specified GPUs over comparable periods, with consistent coverage and accounting.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Continuing growth over a finite observation window cannot contradict an eventual forecast with no deadline.
